protocol.checkpoint_selection: highest validation MRR at the model's own prefix length; strict greater-than tie handling
protocol.validation_split: existing full validation split; used for checkpoint selection only
protocol.test_queries: all samples from the four candidate UIDs only
protocol.test_gallery: all candidate test samples from those same four UIDs, using exact WHY text as multi-positive relevance
protocol.model: MeanPoolBaseline, trained and evaluated at the same prefix length
protocol.text_target_transform: existing frozen 960-to-256 WHY PCA fit on pilot train UIDs (a subset of full train); fixed before candidate test evaluation
protocol.test_usage: one evaluation run after locking; no threshold or model selection from candidate test results

limitations: Candidate set is video-UID-disjoint from pilot training and validation, but not scene-disjoint: garden appeared in pilot validation.
Candidate UIDs had no exact reference in inspected local result files, but unrecorded external use cannot be excluded.
This is a candidate video-level test, not a pristine or scene-independent test benchmark.
The text target PCA was fit on pilot train, not refit on all full-train UIDs.
